notes.title: Version 1.0.21
notes.content:
This update focuses on improved controller support, a complete settings menu overhaul, and numerous fixes.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Gamma correction and slider to configure gamma value in settings
[*] Toast message when a controller is connected or disconnected
[*] Full custom keybinding support for controllers
[*] Custom keybinding support for self-destruct (default ESCAPE) and start (default ENTER)
[/list]
[b]Improved[/b]
[list]
[*] Overhauled settings menu, now organized into tabs and more structured
[*] Better menu navigation with keyboard and controller
[*] Selectboxes and sliders can now be interacted with using keyboard and controller
[*] Explosions after thresher dies now shake the camera, as in the original
[*] Added icons to editor level overview entries and removed file endings
[*] Dynamic sound sources now start playing more quickly
[*] Increased sound volume of gnats, spiders, and generatrices
[*] Many instances of a sound being played in short succession should now be handled better
[*] Better controller support
[*] Reduced installation size
[*] Glows now blend additively
[/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Workshop tab having a line below it when selected
[*] Thresher incorrectly dying after invulnerability wears off
[*] Thresher look direction smoothing being FPS dependent
[*] Sound interpolation being FPS dependent
[*] Explosions that spawn Unids not playing the correct explosion sound
[*] Not every unid making a sound when picked up consecutively at higher game speeds
[*] Skipping when navigating menus with keyboard and controller
[*] Disabled menu control when assigning a new keybind
[*] Certain glows being affected by explosions
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.16
notes.content:
We’re continuing to update Oxrox, with more features planned for future releases. This update adds Steam Rich Presence support, some new achievements, leaderboard improvements and several bug fixes.

[list]
[*][b]Added:[/b] Steam Rich Presence Support - now showing what level is being played or if in editor
[*][b]Added:[/b] Number of ranks to leaderboard
[*][b]Added:[/b] Global Leaderboard for official levels
[*][b]Added:[/b] New achievements Lab Rat Prodigy and Contributor
[*][b]Added:[/b] Game integrity verification
[*][b]Improved:[/b] Server performance for leaderboard queries
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Objects stacking in portal exit
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Different gameplay behavior in reversed gravity
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Gravity switch having wrong direction after loading checkpoint
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Opened pressure gate disappearing after loading checkpoint
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Crash when deleting levels in editor
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Menu being cut off on low width displays, e.g. Steam Deck
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.14
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of Version 1.0.14, which consists mainly of bug fixes and small improvements.

[list]
[*][b]Added[/b]: Ability to move levels to trash within the editor
[*][b]Added[/b]: Option to restart level from Finished-Dialog using restart hotkey
[*][b]Added[/b]: Level Browser entry in the editor's "View" menu
[*][b]Added[/b]: Controller Dead Zone setting
[*][b]Added[/b]: Hint for using ALT + ENTER to toggle fullscreen mode
[*][b]Improved[/b]: Dialogs remain centered when the window is resized
[*][b]Improved[/b]: Enhanced support for low-width window sizes
[*][b]Improved[/b]: Local record replaced if server record for a level is better
[*][b]Improved[/b]: Tooltip explaining game speed implications
[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Loss of UI control when switching to windowed mode in settings
[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Various glitches with secret objects
[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Incorrect display of level times loaded from the server on the level button
[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Camera getting stuck in a shaken orientation
[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Crash when using ESC/ENTER in quick succession after collecting a checkpoint
[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Being rerouted to the play menu if entering settings before levels are loaded
[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Settings menu getting cut off when scrolling is enabled
[*][b]Fixed[/b]: Editor level being selected when returning to play menu from the editor
[/list]
